description:
Secure Cloud Backup & File Sync | Hivenet Cloud Storage

Hivenet is your secure, affordable, and eco-friendly cloud backup for photos, videos, and files. Store, sync, and share data across devices — all while reducing your carbon footprint.

📦 Cloud Storage for Everything
• Backup photos, videos, and files instantly.
• Sync across Android, Windows, and macOS.
• Free up phone space while keeping everything safe in the cloud.

🔒 Private & Encrypted
Your files are encrypted and distributed across Hivenet’s decentralized network. Only you can unlock them — ensuring true privacy.

🌱 Sustainable Cloud
Hivenet cuts cloud emissions by up to 77% using community-powered storage. Share unused space from your devices and save up to 46% on your plan.

💻 Access Anywhere — Even Offline
View, preview, and share files without an internet connection.

🤝 Community-Driven & Trusted Globally
Join thousands of users redefining how cloud storage should work — affordable, green, and secure.

Hivenet — The smarter, greener, and more affordable cloud.
Download now and start your 10 GB free backup.
